objectives: This course introduces the fundamental principles and core techniques of digital image processing, including image enhancement, feature extraction, frequency-domain analysis and transformation of two-dimensional signals, and image compression. It provides foundational knowledge in image signal processing, video signal processing, computer vision, and artificial intelligence. The course also incorporates a semester-long project to strengthen the connection between theoretical foundations and practical applications. This course will be conducted under a Ministry of Education-funded project "Integrating Inquiry-Based Learning into Project-Based Learning for Digital Image Processing".
